modmenu.summaryTranslation.chunkstorageo: Lets Voxy's world import read the .cso region files written by Chunk Storage Optimizer.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.chunkstor: With Voxy installed, /voxy import world and /voxy import current also read the .cso region files written by Chunk Storage Optimizer, not just the vanilla .mca ones. Does nothing without Voxy installed.
